mapper.sql: ee.element_id as "elementId", ei.item_id as "itemId", ea.area_id as "areaId", ea.rule_version_id as "ruleVersionId", erv.version_code as "versionCode", erv.version_status as "versionStatus", ea.area_code as "areaCode", ea.area_name as "areaName", ei.item_code as "itemCode", ei.item_name as "itemName", ee.evaluation_year as "evaluationYear", ee.element_code as "elementCode", ee.element_name as "elementName", ee.sort_order as "sortOrder", ee.active_yn as "activeYn", ee.change_reason as "changeReason", ee.updated_by as "updatedBy", ee.updated_at as "updatedAt"

from evaluation_elements ee inner join evaluation_items ei on ei.item_id = ee.item_id inner join evaluation_areas ea on ea.area_id = ei.area_id inner join evaluation_rule_versions erv on erv.rule_version_id = ea.rule_version_id

where.if: and (ee.element_code ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or ee.element_name ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or ei.item_code ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or ei.item_name ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or ea.area_code ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or ea.area_name ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%'))

mapper.insert: insert into evaluation_elements (item_id, evaluation_year, element_code, element_name, sort_order, active_yn, change_reason, created_by, updated_by) values (#{itemId}, #{request.evaluationYear}, #{request.elementCode}, #{request.elementName}, #{request.sortOrder}, #{request.activeYn}, #{request.changeReason}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedBy}) on conflict (item_id, evaluation_year, element_code) do update set element_name = EXCLUDED.element_name, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, active_yn = EXCLUDED.active_yn, change_reason = EXCLUDED.change_reason, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by

insert into data_change_histories (target_business, target_key, change_type, field_name, before_value, after_value, changed_by, change_reason, request_id) values (#{targetBusiness}, #{targetKey}, #{changeType}, #{fieldName}, #{beforeValue}, #{afterValue}, #{changedBy}, #{changeReason}, #{requestId})
